wiki_acceptance: Dimension 4 (건축) #19: a built lamp emits a light glow at night.
summary: Added a NEW Lamp Mode to the BuildManager catalogue mirroring the Stove/Wall entry EXACTLY (1x1 footprint, wood cost 4, same SetMode/cooldown/ghost/placement-validation/place path, NO new input system). New L hotkey (free; B/F/G/T/Y/N/R/X/M/P all taken). The placed lamp emits a warm night light pool via a NEW self-attached LampGlowDriver (NightLightPoolDriver could NOT auto-detect it — it scans ONLY StoveEntity and gates on MealsAvailable/CanCookOne, and the lane forbids editing it). Lamp sprite generated by a NEW _gen_lamp.py (flat-Kenney 1px OUTLINE_OBJ wood post + FIRE_OR/FIRE_LT flame head). Zero SceneSetup edit: BuildManager builds the lamp prefab + sprite LAZILY (AssetDatabase load in Editor/batchmode + ALWAYS a procedural fallback so a player build is never null/magenta).
detection_decision: NightLightPoolDriver.cs is READ-ONLY and CANNOT auto-detect the lamp without an edit (FindObjectsByType<StoveEntity> + IsStoveLit gate on MealsAvailable>0||CanCookOne). Per the lane contract, instead of editing it I added a tiny NEW self-attached LampGlowDriver.cs that scans for LampEntity and casts the identical warm-amber radial pool with the identical day/night alpha curve, sortingOrder 8 (below pawns), alpha-blend material, and procedural-sprite construction. Visually interchangeable with the stove glow; only the scan target + the always-lit gate differ.

bug_firewall.background_freeze_9: No long WaitForSeconds coroutine; LampGlowDriver uses Time.unscaledTime deltas in Update, same as NightLightPoolDriver. No always-on background timer added.
bug_firewall.audio_throttle_4: No AudioBank calls added in this lane (PlaySelect/PlayBuild are read-only via existing paths; BlueprintEntity.Complete already calls the throttled PlayBuild on lamp completion).
bug_firewall.spawned_entity_8: LampEntity carries no justSpawned-style default-true grace field. IsLit is a pure constant true.
bug_firewall.resources_load_magenta: Avoided the Lane-B scatter trap: lamp sprite/prefab use AssetDatabase(Editor) + a procedural fallback (never Resources.Load), so a player build always shows a real lamp.

buildmanager_changes: lampPrefab/lampSprite SerializeField (null by default — lazy) + _lampPrefabRuntime/_lampSpriteRuntime caches
CellOccupied: LampEntity now blocks placement (no lamp stacking)
EnsureLampSprite / EnsureLampPrefab / LoadOrBuildLampSprite / BuildProceduralLampSprite helpers (lazy, zero-SceneSetup)
qa_flags: SCENE-WIRING (lamp prefab): NO SceneSetup edit was made. BuildManager builds the lamp finished-prefab + sprite lazily/procedurally (AssetDatabase in Editor/batchmode + procedural fallback). If a future wave prefers a real saved .prefab asset, wire lampPrefab/lampSprite via BuildManager.SetRefs from SceneSetup.Game.Prefabs.cs — the lazy builders then become no-ops automatically.

SCENE-WIRING (light-source registration): NO NightLightPoolDriver edit. The lamp glow is cast by the NEW self-bootstrapping LampGlowDriver ([RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)], hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO) — zero scene wiring required.

SCENE-WIRING (Architect catalogue): the lamp is surfaced via the L hotkey only (per 'pick a free build hotkey OR surface via the Architect catalogue'). To ALSO list it in the Architect menu, add a one-line entry to ArchitectMenu.Categories (e.g. under 'Production (생산)': (BuildManager.Mode.Lamp, "램프 (목재 4)", 4)). NOT done here to keep this lane strictly to its declared file set (BuildManager.cs + new lamp files); ArchitectMenu.cs is outside the Lane A proof. Build Engineer / a follow-up may add it.

META (new scripts): LampEntity.cs.meta + LampGlowDriver.cs.meta written with fresh GUIDs (fbformat matches NightLightPoolDriver.cs.meta). lamp.png.meta already existed with correct Point/PPU16/Sprite settings — reused, not modified. QA to confirm Unity accepts these on import.
verify_hint_for_qa: ACCEPTANCE #19: build a lamp (L -> click dirt/grass -> hauler delivers 4 wood -> PawnBuilder completes -> LampEntity spawns). Advance GameClock into night hours (DayProgress in [0.92..0.33] wrapping through 0): a warm amber glow pool (sortingOrder 8, below pawns) should appear under the lamp and be invisible by full day (DayProgress ~0.33..0.71). The pool is procedural so it resolves in batchmode AND a player build with no magenta/null fallback.
